Boil gently until they float and the dough turns slightly translucent, about 30-40 minutes.

dishes.name: Skyr
dishes.description: Thick, protein-rich Icelandic cultured dairy product.

ingredients.name: skyr culture or plain yogurt starter

ingredient_names: skyr culture or plain yogurt starter
steps: Warm the milk gently to about 100°F (38°C).
Stir in the culture and mix well.
Cover and let sit in a warm place for 8-12 hours until thickened and tangy.
Strain through cheesecloth to remove excess whey, thickening it further.
Chill before serving, plain or with a little honey.

dishes.name: Karjalanpiirakka
dishes.description: Karelian rice pastry with a thin rye crust, a Finnish breakfast classic.
steps: Mix rye flour with water into a thin, pliable dough.
Roll into thin ovals.
Spread cooked rice porridge in the center of each oval.
Fold and crimp the edges up around the filling, leaving the center exposed.
Bake at high heat until the edges are lightly browned, then brush with melted butter.

dishes.name: Ají de Gallina
dishes.description: Creamy Peruvian chicken stew colored and spiced by yellow chili.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic with aji amarillo paste until fragrant.
Blend the soaked bread with a little milk until smooth, then stir into the pan.
Add ground walnuts and parmesan, simmering until thickened into a creamy sauce.
Fold in the shredded chicken and warm through.
Serve over rice with sliced boiled egg and olives.

dishes.name: Causa Limeña
dishes.description: Layered chilled potato dish, molded and filled, from Lima.
steps: Mash boiled potato while warm, then mix in aji amarillo paste and lime juice.
Season with salt and let cool completely.
Press a layer of the potato mixture into a mold or dish.
Spread a layer of chicken or tuna salad filling on top.
Top with another layer of potato, chill, then unmold and slice to serve.

dishes.name: Anticuchos
dishes.description: Peruvian grilled skewers, traditionally made from marinated beef heart.
steps: Marinate cubed beef heart in aji panca paste, garlic, cumin, and vinegar for several hours.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over hot coals, turning occasionally, until charred outside and cooked through.
Baste with extra marinade while grilling.
Serve with boiled potato and corn.

dishes.name: Milanesa
dishes.description: Argentine breaded and fried cutlet, similar to schnitzel.
steps: Pound beef cutlets to an even, thin thickness.
Dredge each in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp on both sides.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve with lemon wedges, or topped with tomato and cheese for milanesa a la napolitana.

dishes.name: Provoleta
dishes.description: Grilled provolone cheese, a classic starter at an Argentine asado.
steps: Place a thick slice of provolone in a small cast iron pan or directly on the grill grate over medium heat.
Sprinkle with oregano and a drizzle of olive oil.
Grill until the bottom is golden and the cheese is melted but still holding together.
Carefully flip if using a pan, or serve directly from the grill.
Serve immediately with bread for scooping.

dishes.name: Pozole
dishes.description: Traditional Mexican hominy soup, festive and deeply regional.
steps: Simmer pork with garlic and onion until tender, several hours.
Blend dried chiles into a smooth sauce and stir into the broth.
Add hominy and simmer another 30 minutes.
Shred the cooked pork and return it to the pot.
Serve with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, and oregano on the side.

dishes.name: Birria
dishes.description: Rich, chili-braised meat stew, often served with tortillas for dipping tacos.
steps: Toast and rehydrate dried chiles, then blend into a marinade with garlic and spices.
Marinate beef or goat in the chile paste for several hours.
Simmer the meat in the marinade with broth until falling-apart tender, 2-3 hours.
Shred the meat and strain the cooking liquid into a consommé.
Serve the meat with warm tortillas and a cup of the consommé for dipping.

dishes.name: Elote
dishes.description: Grilled Mexican street corn slathered in creamy, spiced toppings.
steps: Grill corn on the cob until charred in spots.
Brush with mayonnaise or crema.
Sprinkle generously with crumbled cotija cheese and chili powder.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the top.
Serve immediately while hot.

dishes.name: Chilaquiles
dishes.description: Mexican breakfast of fried tortilla chips simmered in salsa.
steps: Cut tortillas into triangles and fry until crisp, or use pre-made tortilla chips.
Warm the salsa in a large pan until simmering.
Toss the crispy chips in the hot salsa just until coated but not soggy.
Plate and top with crumbled queso fresco.
Top each portion with a fried egg.

dishes.name: Tamales
dishes.description: Steamed corn dough parcels filled with meat, cheese, or chilies.
steps: Beat lard or oil into masa dough until light and fluffy.
Spread the masa onto softened corn husks.
Add a spoonful of filling (meat, cheese, or chili) down the center.
Fold the husk around the filling and steam for about an hour until the masa sets.
Unwrap and serve hot.

dishes.name: Mofongo
dishes.description: Mashed fried plantain dish, a Puerto Rican signature.
steps: Cut green plantains into chunks and fry until golden.
Mash the fried plantains with garlic and pork cracklings in a mortar.
Shape the mash into a dome.
Serve alongside garlic sauce or a savory broth poured around the base.
Some versions are stuffed with shrimp or meat in the center.

dishes.name: Arroz con Gandules
dishes.description: Puerto Rico's classic rice and pigeon pea dish.
steps: Sauté sofrito in oil until fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and pigeon peas, cooking briefly.
Add rice and water, stirring to combine.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender, about 20-25 minutes, without stirring.
Fold in olives before serving.

dishes.name: Conch Fritters
dishes.description: Deep-fried fritters made from local conch, a Bahamian favorite.
steps: Mince conch meat finely.
Mix with diced bell pepper, onion, and seasoning.
Whisk flour, egg, and baking powder with a little water into a batter, then fold in the conch mixture.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden and cooked through.
Drain and serve with a dipping sauce.

dishes.name: Kokoda
dishes.description: Fijian version of ceviche, fish cured in citrus and coconut milk.
steps: Cube very fresh white fish and cover with lime juice.
Refrigerate for 15-20 minutes until the fish turns opaque.
Drain some of the excess lime juice.
Mix in coconut milk, diced tomato, onion, and chili.
Chill briefly and serve cold.

dishes.name: Palusami
dishes.description: Taro leaves baked with coconut cream, a Samoan staple.
steps: Layer several taro leaves together to prevent tearing.
Spoon coconut cream and diced onion (and meat if using) into the center.
Fold the leaves tightly around the filling into a parcel.
Wrap in foil or additional leaves and bake or steam for about an hour.
Unwrap and serve the softened, creamy filling with rice.

dishes.name: Beignets
dishes.description: Square, pillowy fried dough dusted heavily with powdered sugar.
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm milk, let it foam.
Mix with flour into a soft dough, then let rise for about an hour.
Roll out and cut into squares.
Fry in hot oil until puffed and golden on both sides.
Dust generously with powdered sugar while still warm.

dishes.name: Fish Tacos
dishes.description: Crispy battered fish tacos, a Baja California classic adopted widely in the US.
steps: Dip fish pieces in beer batter.
Fry until golden and crisp, then drain.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill each tortilla with a piece of fried fish and a handful of cabbage slaw.
Drizzle with crema and a squeeze of lime.

dishes.name: Cobb Salad
dishes.description: Composed American salad with rows of chopped toppings.
steps: Arrange chopped lettuce as a base on a large platter.
Arrange rows of diced chicken, crumbled bacon, sliced egg, blue cheese, and diced avocado across the top.
Add halved cherry tomatoes for color.
Keep the toppings in neat rows rather than tossed.
Serve with a vinaigrette on the side, tossed together just before eating.

dishes.name: Apple Pie
dishes.description: Classic American baked pie, a cultural symbol as much as a dessert.
steps: Make a butter pie dough and chill it.
Toss sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon, and a little flour.
Roll out the dough and line a pie dish with half of it.
Fill with the apple mixture and cover with the second dough round, sealing and venting the top.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 45-50 minutes until the crust is golden and filling is bubbling.

dishes.name: Biscuits and Gravy
dishes.description: Southern breakfast of flaky biscuits smothered in peppery sausage gravy.
steps: Make flaky buttermilk biscuits and bake until golden.
Brown breakfast sausage in a skillet, breaking it into crumbles.
Sprinkle flour over the sausage and cook briefly to form a roux.
Gradually whisk in milk, simmering until thick and peppery.
Split warm biscuits and ladle the sausage gravy generously over the top.

dishes.name: Cornbread
dishes.description: Slightly sweet, crumbly baked bread made from cornmeal.
steps: Whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk buttermilk, egg, and melted butter.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients just until mixed.
Pour into a greased pan or hot skillet.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

dishes.name: Polenta
dishes.description: Creamy or firm cornmeal porridge, a staple of Northern Italian cuisine.
steps: Bring water or stock to a boil.
Whisk in cornmeal gradually to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently, for about 30-40 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in butter and parmesan.
Serve soft, or pour into a dish to cool and firm up for slicing and grilling later.

dishes.name: Osso Buco
dishes.description: Braised veal shanks, traditionally finished with a lemon-herb gremolata.
steps: Dredge veal shanks in flour and brown well on all sides.
Sauté diced carrot, celery, and onion in the same pot until softened.
Return the shanks, add white wine and enough stock to come partway up the sides.
Cover and braise at 325°F (160°C) for about 2 hours until very tender.
Finish with a sprinkle of fresh gremolata before serving.

dishes.name: Yakitori
dishes.description: Grilled skewered chicken, glazed with a sweet-savory sauce.
steps: Thread chicken and scallion pieces alternately onto skewers.
Grill over charcoal or high heat, turning occasionally.
Baste repeatedly with tare sauce as it cooks, building up a glossy glaze.
Cook until the chicken is fully cooked through and lightly charred.
Serve hot, straight off the grill.

dishes.name: Unagi Don
dishes.description: Glazed grilled eel served over a bowl of rice.
steps: Warm pre-grilled eel gently, basting with sweet soy glaze.
Grill or broil briefly until the glaze caramelizes slightly.
Slice the eel into pieces.
Arrange over a bowl of hot steamed rice.
Drizzle with extra glaze and a sprinkle of sansho pepper if available.

dishes.name: Crème Brûlée
dishes.description: Rich custard dessert topped with a brittle layer of caramelized sugar.
steps: Warm cream with a scraped vanilla bean until just simmering.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale, then slowly temper in the warm cream.
Strain and pour into ramekins.
Bake in a water bath at 325°F (160°C) until just set with a slight jiggle, about 35-40 minutes.
Chill, then sprinkle sugar on top and caramelize with a torch just before serving.

dishes.name: Profiteroles
dishes.description: Cream-filled pastry puffs drizzled with warm chocolate sauce.
steps: Pipe small mounds of choux pastry onto a baking sheet.
Bake until puffed, golden, and hollow inside.
Let cool completely, then slice each puff and fill with cream.
Stack filled puffs on a plate.
Drizzle generously with warm chocolate sauce just before serving.

dishes.name: Panna Cotta
dishes.description: Silky Italian set cream dessert, often served with fruit or caramel.
steps: Bloom gelatin in a little cold water.
Warm cream with sugar and vanilla until the sugar dissolves.
Whisk the bloomed gelatin into the warm cream until fully dissolved.
Pour into molds or ramekins.
Chill for at least 4 hours until set, then unmold or serve directly in the ramekin.

dishes.name: Cannoli
dishes.description: Sicilian fried pastry tubes filled with sweetened ricotta.
steps: Drain ricotta well to remove excess moisture.
Whip the ricotta with powdered sugar until smooth and sweetened.
Fold in mini chocolate chips.
Pipe the filling into cannoli shells just before serving to keep them crisp.
Dust with extra powdered sugar.

dishes.name: Gelato
dishes.description: Dense, intensely flavored Italian frozen dessert.
steps: Warm milk and cream together until steaming.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar, then temper in the warm milk mixture.
Cook gently over low heat, stirring, until the mixture thickens slightly to coat a spoon.
Chill the base completely, then churn in an ice cream maker.
Freeze until firm, softening slightly before serving.

dishes.name: Macaron
dishes.description: Delicate almond meringue sandwich cookies in bright colors.
steps: Sift almond flour and powdered sugar together.
Whip egg whites to soft peaks, then gradually add granulated sugar to stiff, glossy peaks.
Fold the almond mixture into the meringue until it flows in a thick ribbon.
Pipe small rounds onto a lined baking sheet and let rest until a skin forms, about 30 minutes.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) until they develop feet and are set, about 15 minutes, then sandwich with filling.

dishes.name: Banoffee Pie
dishes.description: British pie layering banana, toffee, and cream over a biscuit crust.
steps: Press a biscuit crumb crust into a pie dish and chill.
Spread a thick layer of dulce de leche or toffee over the crust.
Layer sliced banana over the toffee.
Top generously with whipped cream.
Chill before serving, dusted with cocoa or chocolate shavings.

dishes.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
dishes.description: Moist date cake soaked in a rich toffee sauce, a British classic.
steps: Soak chopped dates in hot water with baking soda until softened, then blend into a puree.
Cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs and the date puree.
Fold in flour and pour into a baking dish.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) until a skewer comes out clean, about 30-35 minutes.
Make a toffee sauce by simmering butter, brown sugar, and cream, then pour warm over the cake.

dishes.name: Mochi
dishes.description: Chewy pounded rice cakes, often filled with sweet bean paste or ice cream.
steps: Whisk glutinous rice flour, sugar, and water together until smooth.
Microwave or steam the mixture in short intervals, stirring between each, until it becomes thick and translucent.
Dust a work surface generously with cornstarch and turn out the hot dough.
Divide and flatten small portions, then wrap around a spoonful of sweet filling.
Pinch closed and dust off excess cornstarch before serving.

dishes.name: Dorayaki
dishes.description: Two small pancakes sandwiching a sweet red bean filling.
steps: Whisk eggs, honey, and sugar together, then fold in flour and a little water to make a thick pancake batter.
Rest the batter for 15 minutes.
Cook small rounds on a griddle like pancakes until golden on both sides.
Spread red bean paste generously on the flat side of one pancake.
Sandwich with a second pancake, flat sides together.

dishes.name: Gulab Jamun
dishes.description: Deep-fried milk dumplings soaked in fragrant sugar syrup.
steps: Mix milk powder, flour, and a little milk into a soft dough.
Shape into small smooth balls, taking care to avoid cracks.
Fry the balls in oil on low-medium heat until deeply golden all over, turning gently.
Make a light sugar syrup with cardamom and rosewater.
Soak the fried balls in the warm syrup for at least an hour before serving.

dishes.name: Rasgulla
dishes.description: Spongy Bengali cheese balls soaked in light syrup.
steps: Bring milk to a boil, then add lemon juice to curdle it, separating curds from whey.
Strain and rinse the curds (chenna), then knead until smooth.
Shape into small smooth balls.
Boil the balls in a light sugar syrup until they double in size and become spongy, about 15-20 minutes.
Chill in the syrup before serving.

dishes.name: Kheer
dishes.description: North Indian rice pudding, fragrant with cardamom and nuts.
steps: Simmer rice in milk over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soft and the milk has thickened considerably, about 45 minutes.
Add sugar and cardamom, stirring until dissolved.
Continue simmering until the desired creamy consistency is reached.
Fry nuts and raisins in a little ghee and stir in.
Serve warm or chilled.

dishes.name: Turkish Delight
dishes.description: Chewy, fragrant gel-based confection dusted with powdered sugar.
steps: Dissolve sugar in water and bring to a simmer.
In a separate pot, whisk cornstarch with cold water into a smooth slurry, then combine with the sugar syrup.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until it becomes very thick and translucent, about 45 minutes.
Stir in rosewater and pour into a greased pan to set for several hours.
Cut into squares and toss generously in powdered sugar.

dishes.name: Halva
dishes.description: Dense, sweet confection found across the Middle East, made from tahini or semolina.
steps: Heat sugar and water together until it reaches a thick syrup stage.
Warm the tahini slightly so it's pourable.
Combine the hot syrup with the tahini, stirring vigorously until it starts to thicken.
Pour into a lined pan and press down firmly.
Let it cool and set completely before slicing into pieces.

dishes.name: Basbousa
dishes.description: Sweet semolina cake soaked in syrup, popular across the Arab world.
steps: Mix semolina, yogurt, sugar, and shredded coconut into a thick batter.
Spread evenly into a greased baking pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) until golden, about 25-30 minutes.
While still hot, pour cooled sugar syrup evenly over the cake.
Let it soak in fully before cutting into diamond shapes.

dishes.name: Flan
dishes.description: Silky caramel custard popular across Spain and Latin America.
steps: Melt sugar in a pan until it turns a deep amber caramel, then pour into a baking dish, swirling to coat the bottom.
Whisk eggs, condensed milk, and evaporated milk together until smooth.
Pour the custard over the caramel.
Bake in a water bath at 350°F (180°C) for about 45-50 minutes until set.
Chill completely, then invert onto a plate so the caramel becomes a sauce.

dishes.name: Tres Leches Cake
dishes.description: Sponge cake soaked in a blend of three milks until fully saturated.
steps: Bake a light sponge cake and let it cool completely.
Poke holes all over the cake with a fork.
Whisk together evaporated milk, condensed milk, and heavy cream.
Pour the milk mixture slowly over the cake, letting it soak in fully.
Top with whipped cream and chill before serving.

dishes.name: Dulce de Leche
dishes.description: Thick, caramelized milk spread, central to Argentine desserts.
steps: Combine milk, sugar, baking soda, and vanilla in a heavy pot.
Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally.
Continue simmering for 1.5-2 hours, stirring more frequently as it thickens, until deeply caramel-colored and thick.
Watch closely near the end to prevent scorching.
Cool completely; it will thicken further as it cools.

dishes.name: Koeksisters
dishes.description: Braided fried dough soaked in cold syrup for a crisp, sticky finish.
steps: Make a soft yeasted dough and let it rise for about an hour.
Roll out and cut into strips, braiding three strips together for each koeksister.
Deep fry the braided dough until golden and cooked through.
Immediately dunk the hot fried dough into very cold sugar syrup.
Let soak briefly, then drain and serve.

dishes.name: Eggs Benedict
dishes.description: Poached eggs over muffin and ham, topped with buttery hollandaise sauce.
steps: Toast split english muffins.
Warm canadian bacon in a pan.
Poach eggs gently in barely simmering water with a splash of vinegar until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Assemble muffin, bacon, and poached egg.
Top generously with warm hollandaise sauce.

dishes.name: American Pancakes
dishes.description: Fluffy stacked griddle cakes, usually served with butter and syrup.
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, and baking powder together.
In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients just until mixed, leaving some lumps.
Cook ladlefuls on a hot, lightly greased griddle until bubbles form on top, then flip.
Cook the second side until golden, and serve with butter and maple syrup.

dishes.name: French Toast
dishes.description: Bread soaked in egg custard and pan-fried until golden.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, and cinnamon together in a shallow dish.
Soak each slice of bread briefly on both sides.
Cook on a buttered griddle until golden brown on both sides.
Keep warm while cooking the remaining slices.
Serve with butter, syrup, or fresh fruit.

dishes.name: Huevos Rancheros
dishes.description: Fried eggs served over tortillas with a spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Warm the corn tortillas.
Spread a layer of refried beans on each tortilla.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Place a fried egg on top of the beans on each tortilla.
Spoon warm salsa ranchera generously over the top before serving.

dishes.name: Scottish Porridge
dishes.description: Simple, traditional Scottish oatmeal, often eaten with just a pinch of salt.
steps: Bring water or milk to a gentle boil.
Stir in oats and a pinch of salt.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 5-10 minutes until thickened to your liking.
Let it rest a minute off the heat before serving.
Serve simply, traditionally with just a little extra salt, or with milk and a touch of sugar.

dishes.name: Muesli
dishes.description: Raw oat and fruit breakfast cereal, developed by a Swiss physician.
steps: Combine rolled oats with chopped nuts and dried fruit.
Store the dry mixture in an airtight container.
Soak a portion in milk or yogurt overnight in the fridge (bircher-style), or serve immediately with cold milk.
Top with fresh fruit if desired.
Serve chilled.

dishes.name: Nachos
dishes.description: Tortilla chips loaded with melted cheese and toppings, a Tex-Mex bar staple.
steps: Spread tortilla chips in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Scatter shredded cheese generously over the chips.
Add sliced jalapeño.
Bake or broil until the cheese is fully melted and bubbling.
Top with salsa, sour cream, and guacamole before serving.

dishes.name: Onion Bhaji
dishes.description: Crispy fried onion fritters, a popular Indian snack.
steps: Toss thinly sliced onion with chickpea flour and spices.
Add just enough water to bind the mixture into a thick, clumpy batter.
Heat oil until hot.
Drop clumps of the onion mixture into the oil and fry until deep golden and crisp.
Drain and serve with chutney.

dishes.name: Pakora
dishes.description: Battered and deep-fried vegetable fritters.
steps: Slice vegetables (potato, onion, spinach, or a mix) thinly.
Whisk chickpea flour with spices and water into a thick batter.
Dip the vegetable slices into the batter, coating well.
Deep fry until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with chutney or ketchup.

dishes.name: Kachori
dishes.description: Flaky fried pastry stuffed with spiced lentils or peas.

ingredients.name: moong dal or peas, cooked and spiced

ingredient_names: moong dal or peas, cooked and spiced
steps: Make a firm dough from flour, a little oil, and water, then rest it.
Mash cooked, spiced lentils or peas for the filling.
Wrap a portion of dough around a spoonful of filling and seal, then flatten slightly.
Deep fry on low-medium heat until deep golden and flaky, taking care they cook through without burning.
Drain and serve with chutney.

dishes.name: Vada Pav
dishes.description: Mumbai's iconic potato fritter sandwich, sometimes called the Indian burger.
steps: Mash boiled potato with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and spices to make the vada filling.
Shape into small balls.
Dip each ball in chickpea flour batter and deep fry until golden.
Split the bread rolls and spread with chutney.
Sandwich a hot vada inside each roll.

dishes.name: Bhel Puri
dishes.description: Tangy, crunchy puffed rice snack mixed with chutneys and vegetables.
steps: Combine puffed rice with diced onion and tomato in a large bowl.
Add tamarind chutney and a spicy green chutney to taste.
Toss quickly and thoroughly, as puffed rice softens fast.
Top with crunchy sev.
Serve immediately for maximum crunch.

dishes.name: Pani Puri
dishes.description: Crisp hollow shells filled with spiced tangy water, eaten in one bite.
steps: Prepare a well-spiced, tangy tamarind water and chill it.
Fill a small bowl with mashed potato and chickpeas.
Gently crack a small hole in the top of each puri shell.
Fill each with a spoonful of the potato mixture.
Dip or fill with the spiced water just before eating in one bite.

dishes.name: Aloo Tikki
dishes.description: Crisp spiced potato patties, often served with chutneys.
steps: Mix mashed potato with peas and spices.
Shape into small flat patties.
Coat lightly in breadcrumbs for extra crispness.
Pan-fry in a little oil until golden and crisp on both sides.
Serve with chutneys or as part of chaat.

dishes.name: Zhajiangmian
dishes.description: Northern Chinese noodles tossed in a savory fermented soybean paste sauce.
steps: Brown ground pork in a hot pan.
Add fermented soybean paste and a little water, simmering until thickened into a rich, savory sauce.
Cook noodles until tender and drain well.
Top the noodles with the pork sauce.
Garnish with julienned cucumber and scallion, tossing together before eating.

dishes.name: Dan Dan Noodles
dishes.description: Sichuan noodles in a spicy, numbing chili and sesame sauce.
steps: Fry ground pork with preserved vegetables until crisp and fragrant.
Whisk sesame paste, chili oil, soy sauce, and a little stock into a sauce in each serving bowl.
Cook noodles and drain.
Add the hot noodles directly to the sauce in each bowl.
Top with the crispy pork mixture and toss together before eating.

dishes.name: Egg Fried Rice
dishes.description: Simple wok-fried rice with egg, a foundational Chinese home dish.
steps: Beat eggs and scramble them lightly in a hot wok, then remove.
Add a little more oil and stir-fry the cold, day-old rice, breaking up clumps.
Return the scrambled egg to the wok.
Season with soy sauce and toss everything together over high heat.
Finish with chopped scallion just before serving.

dishes.name: Baozi
dishes.description: Fluffy steamed buns filled with savory or sweet fillings.
steps: Make a soft yeasted dough and let it rise until doubled.
Mix ground pork with scallion, ginger, and seasoning for the filling.
Roll dough into small rounds and place a spoonful of filling in the center.
Pleat and twist the top closed to seal.
Steam for 15-18 minutes until puffed and cooked through.

dishes.name: Youtiao
key_ingredients: eaten with soy milk or congee
dishes.description: Long, airy fried dough stick, a classic Chinese breakfast food.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and baking soda with water into a soft, slightly sticky dough.
Let the dough rest for at least an hour, or ideally overnight, covered.
Roll out and cut into strips, stacking two strips together and pressing a chopstick down the middle to join them.
Stretch each pair gently and drop into hot oil.
Fry, turning frequently, until puffed, golden, and hollow inside.

dishes.name: Scallion Pancake
dishes.description: Flaky, layered savory pancake studded with scallions.
steps: Mix flour with boiling water to form a dough, then knead until smooth and rest it.
Roll the dough thin, brush with sesame oil, and scatter chopped scallion over the surface.
Roll the dough up into a log, then coil it into a spiral and flatten again.
Roll the coiled dough flat once more into a round.
Pan-fry in oil until golden and crisp on both sides, with visible flaky layers.

dishes.name: Kimbap
dishes.description: Korean seaweed rice rolls, similar to sushi but seasoned differently.

ingredients.name: cooked rice, seasoned with sesame oil
egg, cooked into a thin sheet

ingredient_names: cooked rice, seasoned with sesame oil
egg, cooked into a thin sheet
steps: Prepare and lightly season rice with sesame oil and a pinch of salt.
Lay a seaweed sheet on a bamboo mat and spread rice evenly, leaving a border at the top.
Arrange strips of carrot, pickled radish, spinach, and egg across the center.
Roll tightly using the mat, sealing the border with a little water.
Slice into rounds with a sharp knife.

dishes.name: Korean Fried Chicken
dishes.description: Extra-crispy double-fried chicken, often coated in a sweet-spicy glaze.
steps: Coat chicken pieces in a light cornstarch batter.
Fry once until cooked through, then let rest.
Fry a second time briefly for extra crispness.
Make a sauce from gochujang, garlic, and a little honey.
Toss the fried chicken in the sauce and serve immediately.

dishes.name: Naengmyeon
dishes.description: Chilled buckwheat noodles in icy broth, a refreshing summer dish.
steps: Chill beef broth thoroughly, seasoning with a little vinegar and sugar.
Cook buckwheat noodles briefly, then rinse under cold water until fully chilled.
Divide noodles into bowls and pour the icy broth over them.
Top with sliced cucumber, pear, and boiled egg.
Serve immediately with a drizzle of mustard and vinegar to taste.

dishes.name: Bánh Cuốn
dishes.description: Delicate steamed rice rolls filled with seasoned pork and mushroom.
steps: Cook ground pork with minced mushroom and seasoning for the filling.
Steam a thin layer of rice batter on a cloth stretched over boiling water until set.
Scrape off the thin sheet and place a spoonful of filling in the center.
Roll gently into a soft parcel.
Serve with fried shallots and dipping sauce.

dishes.name: Cơm Tấm
dishes.description: Broken rice served with grilled pork, a beloved Saigon dish.
steps: Marinate pork chops in fish sauce, garlic, and a little sugar for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the pork chops until charred and cooked through.
Cook broken rice separately.
Serve the grilled pork over the rice with pickled vegetables on the side.
Drizzle with a light fish sauce dressing before eating.

dishes.name: Chin Chin
dishes.description: Crunchy, lightly sweet fried dough snack, common at Nigerian celebrations.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, and nutmeg together.
Rub in melted butter, then add milk to form a firm dough.
Roll out the dough and cut into small strips or squares.
Deep fry in batches until golden brown and crunchy.
Cool completely before storing, as they firm up further as they cool.

dishes.name: Puff Puff
dishes.description: Fluffy, deep-fried sweet dough balls found across West Africa.
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let it foam.
Mix with flour into a thick, sticky batter, then let it rise for about an hour until bubbly.
Heat oil until hot.
Scoop small portions of the batter with a wet hand or spoon directly into the oil.
Fry until puffed and deeply golden all over, then drain.

dishes.name: Irio
dishes.description: Kenyan mashed dish of potatoes, corn, peas, and greens.
steps: Boil potato, corn, and peas together until all are tender.
Mash everything together, keeping some texture.
Stir in chopped greens and cook briefly until wilted.
Season with salt.
Serve warm as a hearty side.

dishes.name: Bunny Chow
dishes.description: Durban curry served inside a hollowed-out loaf of bread.
steps: Cut a loaf of bread into quarters and hollow out the center of each, reserving the bread removed.
Prepare a well-spiced curry, simmered until thick.
Fill each hollowed bread quarter generously with hot curry.
Use the reserved bread as a lid or side for scooping.
Serve immediately while the curry is hot and the bread is soaking it up.

dishes.name: Musakhan
dishes.description: Palestine's national dish of sumac-spiced chicken over flatbread.
steps: Rub chicken pieces with sumac, allspice, and olive oil.
Roast or bake until golden and cooked through.
Slowly caramelize a generous amount of onion with more sumac until deep and jammy.
Spread the caramelized onion over flatbread.
Top with the roasted chicken and scatter with toasted pine nuts.

dishes.name: New England Clam Chowder
dishes.description: Creamy chowder loaded with clams and potatoes, a New England classic.
steps: Render salt pork or bacon in a large pot.
Sauté onion in the fat, then add diced potato and clam juice.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in cream and chopped clams, warming through without boiling hard.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with oyster crackers.

dishes.name: Key Lime Pie
dishes.description: Tart, creamy pie made from small Florida key limes.
steps: Whisk condensed milk, egg yolks, and key lime juice together until smooth.
Pour into the prepared graham cracker crust.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for about 15 minutes until just set.
Cool completely, then chill for at least 2 hours.
Top with whipped cream before serving.

dishes.name: S'mores
dishes.description: Campfire treat of toasted marshmallow and chocolate between graham crackers.
steps: Break graham crackers into squares and lay out chocolate pieces on half of them.
Toast marshmallows over a campfire or open flame until golden and gooey.
Place a hot marshmallow onto the chocolate-topped cracker.
Top with the second cracker and press gently to melt the chocolate.
Eat immediately while warm and gooey.

dishes.name: Kanelbulle
dishes.description: Swedish cinnamon bun, celebrated with its own national day.
steps: Make a soft yeasted dough with flour, milk, and butter, then let it rise for an hour.
Roll the dough into a large rectangle and spread with softened butter, cinnamon, and sugar.
Roll up tightly into a log and slice into rounds.
Place the rounds in muffin tins or on a baking sheet and let rise again briefly.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden, about 15-18 minutes.

dishes.name: Belgian Waffles
dishes.description: Light, deep-pocketed waffles, a Belgian specialty distinct from American versions.
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm milk and let it foam.
Mix with flour, egg, and melted butter into a thick batter, then let it rise for about an hour.
Fold in pearl sugar just before cooking.
Cook in a hot waffle iron until deeply golden and the sugar caramelizes into crunchy spots.
Serve warm, plain or with toppings.

dishes.name: Tostones
dishes.description: Twice-fried green plantain slices, crispy outside and soft within.
steps: Peel green plantains and cut into thick rounds.
Fry the rounds in oil until just softened, not browned, then remove.
Flatten each piece with the bottom of a glass or a tostonera.
Fry the flattened pieces again until crisp and golden.
Sprinkle with salt and serve hot.

dishes.name: Chimichurri
dishes.description: Bright, herby sauce essential to Argentine grilled meats.
steps: Finely chop parsley and mince garlic.
Combine with oregano, red wine vinegar, and a pinch of chili flakes.
Whisk in olive oil until well combined.
Let the sauce sit for at least 30 minutes for the flavors to meld.
Spoon generously over grilled meats.

dishes.name: Spam Musubi
dishes.description: Hawaiian snack of grilled spam over rice, wrapped in seaweed like sushi.
steps: Fry sliced spam until browned on both sides, then glaze with a soy-sugar mixture.
Press a layer of rice into a musubi mold (or use the empty spam can) on a strip of nori.
Top the rice with a slice of glazed spam.
Press down firmly to compact.
Wrap the nori around the rice and spam, sealing with a little water.

dishes.name: Escargot
dishes.description: Snails baked in garlic and parsley butter, a classic French starter.
steps: Clean and prepare snails (or use canned, pre-cleaned snails).
Make a compound butter with garlic, parsley, and softened butter.
Place a snail in each shell (or in an escargot dish) and top generously with the garlic butter.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) until the butter is bubbling, about 8-10 minutes.
Serve hot with crusty bread to mop up the butter.

dishes.name: Spätzle
dishes.description: Soft, irregular egg noodles, a Southern German staple.
steps: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt into a thick, elastic batter.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.
Press the batter through a spaetzle maker or colander directly into the boiling water.
Cook until the small dumplings float, then scoop out.
Toss with melted butter, and cheese if making käsespätzle.

dishes.name: Black Pudding
dishes.description: Savory blood sausage, a traditional part of a full breakfast.
steps: Combine pork blood with oats, diced fat, and minced onion.
Season generously with black pepper and traditional spices.
Stuff the mixture into casings, or pack into a loaf-shaped mold.
Simmer gently in water until firm and cooked through.
Slice and pan-fry until crisp before serving, traditionally as part of a fry-up.

dishes.name: Cornish Pasty
dishes.description: Hand-held pastry parcel of meat and vegetables, originally miners' lunch food.
steps: Roll pastry into large rounds.
Combine diced beef, potato, swede, and onion, seasoning well.
Pile the filling onto one half of each pastry round.
Fold over and crimp the edge into a thick rope-like seal along the side.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for about 45 minutes until deeply golden.

dishes.name: Welsh Rarebit
dishes.description: Savory cheese sauce spiked with mustard and ale, poured over toast.
steps: Melt cheese slowly with beer, mustard, and a little butter, stirring until smooth.
Season with a dash of worcestershire sauce.
Toast the bread until golden.
Pour the hot cheese sauce generously over the toast.
Broil briefly until bubbling and lightly browned on top.

dishes.name: Crêpe
dishes.description: Thin, delicate French pancakes, sweet or savory depending on the filling.
steps: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, and melted butter into a thin, smooth batter.
Let the batter rest for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered crepe pan or skillet.
Pour a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat the pan, and cook until lightly golden, then flip briefly.
Fill or top with sweet or savory fillings of choice.

dishes.name: Pain au Chocolat
dishes.description: Buttery, flaky pastry wrapped around a strip of chocolate.
steps: Roll out laminated dough into a large rectangle and cut into smaller rectangles.
Place a chocolate baton near one edge of each piece and roll partway.
Add a second chocolate baton and continue rolling into a log shape.
Brush with egg wash and let proof until puffy.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) until deeply golden and flaky, about 18-20 minutes.

dishes.name: Bibim Guksu
dishes.description: Cold spicy noodles tossed in a tangy gochujang dressing.
steps: Cook thin wheat noodles until tender, then rinse under cold water until chilled.
Mix gochujang with vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil for the sauce.
Toss the cold noodles with the sauce until well coated.
Top with julienned cucumber and a halved boiled egg.
Serve cold, tossing again at the table.

dishes.name: Taiwanese Hot Pot
dishes.description: Communal simmering pot popular for gatherings, milder than Sichuan style.
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer in a pot at the center of the table.
Arrange thin-sliced meats, vegetables, and tofu on platters around the pot.
Each diner cooks their own ingredients briefly in the simmering broth.
Dip cooked items in the sesame-soy sauce before eating.
Continue adding ingredients throughout the meal, and finish with noodles in the flavorful remaining broth.

dishes.name: Durban Curry
dishes.description: Fragrant, deeply spiced curry reflecting South Africa's Indian community heritage.
steps: Prepare a richly spiced, thick lamb curry, simmered until the sauce clings to the meat.
Cut a loaf of bread into quarters and hollow out the center of each.
Fill each hollow generously with the hot curry.
Use the removed bread as a lid or side for scooping.
Serve immediately while hot, letting the bread soak up the sauce.

dishes.name: Ghanaian Rice and Beans
dishes.description: Everyday Ghanaian staple, rice and beans cooked together and colored naturally.
steps: Boil black-eyed peas with millet leaves until the peas are nearly tender and the cooking liquid turns deep red-brown.
Remove the leaves, then add rice to the same pot.
Cook covered until the rice is tender and has absorbed the color and flavor.
Fluff and serve with a side of stew.
Add gari and boiled egg alongside, as is traditional.

dishes.name: Cochinita Pibil
dishes.description: Yucatán slow-roasted pork marinated in citrus and annatto.
steps: Blend achiote paste with sour orange juice and garlic into a marinade.
Marinate the pork in this mixture for several hours or overnight.
Wrap the marinated pork tightly in banana leaves.
Slow roast at 300°F (150°C) for 3-4 hours until completely tender and shreddable.
Shred the meat and serve with pickled red onion and warm tortillas.

dishes.name: Mole Negro
dishes.description: Oaxaca's dark, complex mole sauce, deeper and smokier than mole poblano.
steps: Toast dried chilies carefully until fragrant but not burnt, then rehydrate in hot water.
Blend the chilies with tomato, plantain, and toasted spices into a smooth paste.
Fry the paste in oil, stirring constantly, until deeply darkened.
Add broth and chocolate, simmering for 45-60 minutes until thick and glossy.
Serve over poached or roasted chicken.

dishes.name: Chicken Paprikash
dishes.description: Creamy Hungarian paprika chicken stew, often served with dumplings.
steps: Sauté onion until soft.
Add paprika and stir briefly off the heat to avoid burning it.
Add chicken pieces and a little water, then cover and simmer until tender, about 30-40 minutes.
Stir in sour cream at the end, off the heat, to prevent curdling.
Serve over small egg dumplings.

dishes.name: Zapiekanka
dishes.description: Polish open-faced baguette snack topped with mushrooms and melted cheese.
steps: Toast the halved baguette lightly.
Top with sautéed mushrooms.
Cover generously with shredded cheese.
Broil until the cheese is fully melted and bubbling.
Drizzle with ketchup before serving.

dishes.name: Piroshki
dishes.description: Small stuffed buns, fried or baked, filled with savory or sweet fillings.
steps: Prepare a soft yeasted dough and let it rise.
Divide into portions and flatten each into a round.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center and pinch closed into an oval shape.
Fry in oil until golden on both sides, or bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden.
Serve warm.

dishes.name: Shchi
dishes.description: Traditional Russian cabbage soup, one of the country's oldest dishes.
steps: Simmer meat in water with bay leaf until tender, skimming as needed.
Add carrot and onion, cooking until softened.
Add shredded cabbage and simmer until just tender, keeping some texture.
Season with salt and a touch of vinegar or tomato for tang.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream and rye bread.
